title: Present Stock write-off cases as accessible worklist
head: feature/stock-writeoff-cases-demo
body:
Write-off cases now use a responsive disclosure worklist over the existing one-balance projection. Summaries show exact requested quantity/unit, reason and state; missing quantity reads Unavailable while zero remains0. Count defaults and the disabled primitive path remain supported. The original history, authority and global dialog behavior remain; governed reversal reasons use contextual Correction wording instead of the receipt-specific shared label.

Stacked on #1196 (`feature/stock-batch-holds-demo`). Five scoped files, no backend/grants/schema change. Existing assertions remain intact; additive tests cover actual rendered writeoff/count behavior, zero/null, one empty state, contextual reversal wording and immutable approval/reversal target/version/retry identity after list refresh.

Validation: types/full lint/format and production build; existing backend30tests548assertions, focused15tests. Final full frontend2,251/2,251 passed. Actual synthetic UI proved proposal, independent approval, a competing stale approval refusal with dialog retained, and independently approved linked reversal. Exactly one1tablet stock_writeoff and one1tablet adjustment_in restore all balances; stale request appends nothing. Read-only CA sees no write commands. Four390/1440 light/dark worklist captures, keyboard disclosure and44/36 controls checked; no overflow/browser errors.

This is bounded write-off case presentation, not complete demo parity. Multi-line sessions, Returned commands and proposer display metadata remain separate explicit backend contract gaps. Artifacts: `/workspace/kpone-validation/stock-writeoff-cases/` with frozen patch, manifest, independent review and browser/ledger evidence. No production action or merge.
